voyage.text: The guiding star is shining in the sky again.
Now the boats won't get lost, right?
Today let's visit the island across the sea. It's Hutton Island.
It was bright, then it went dark… oh, it's bright again!

prologue.text: Don't be scared. We came from Puppy Land. Who are you?
I'm… the keeper who looks after this island.
The island is strange these days. The sun rises and sets right away, and rain suddenly turns to snow.
Look over there. The sundial in the middle of the island is broken.
A sundial tells the time with the shadow the sun makes. When it broke, this island's time got all mixed up.
The pieces flew to the hills, the beach and the valley.
So that's why the island is so strange… You must have been so worried.
But why did the sundial break?
I don't know. One night there was a big thump, and then it was broken.
Don't worry. We'll find all the pieces. And we'll find out why it broke!
…Really? Thank you. I'll show you the way.
